name: divider
title: Divider
description: A versatile divider component for creating visual separation between content elements. Supports multiple variants including line, text, and content dividers.

docs.lead: A versatile divider component for creating visual separation between content elements.

examples.title: Line with Spacing
examples.description: A line divider with vertical spacing.

examples.title: Line with Text
examples.description: A divider with centered text between the lines.

examples.title: Solid Text
examples.description: Text on a solid background with uppercase styling, commonly used in modals.

examples.title: Content
examples.description: A divider with centered content elements like icons or buttons.
examples.code:
<Divider.Root variant="content">
  <Button.Root variant="neutral" mode="stroke" size="xsmall" iconOnly>
    <Button.Icon as={RiAddLine} />
  </Button.Root>
</Divider.Root>

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual style of the divider

props.name: children
props.description: Content to display (for text and content variants)
